hypothesis: The first-pass four-accumulator variant measured 5.26604e-7 seconds versus 5.25586e-7 for the single-accumulator two-pass version, a small difference that does not establish an effect. This experiment keeps the single vector-minimum recurrence and instead unrolls the equality search across four vectors before checking for a match. Reducing loop and mask-check frequency may help when the search prefix is long, but loading a whole group can waste work on earlier matches; random and decreasing inputs may therefore behave differently.
